items.name: Config
items.summary: The configuration used to determine a DFA's start state for a search.

methods.name: anchored
methods.summary: Set the anchored mode of a search.

methods.name: from_input_forward
methods.summary: A convenience routine for building a start configuration from an [`Input`] for a forward search.

methods.name: from_input_reverse
methods.summary: A convenience routine for building a start configuration from an [`Input`] for a reverse search.

methods.name: get_anchored
methods.summary: Return the anchored mode in this configuration.

methods.name: get_look_behind
methods.summary: Return the look-behind byte in this configuration, if one exists.

methods.name: look_behind
methods.summary: Set the look-behind byte at the start of a search.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new default start configuration.
